critique.evidence: Strong, coherent defense-console art direction: disciplined near-black palette, cyan/green/yellow semantic accents, crisp borders, and an excellent desktop headline-to-evidence hierarchy. Tablet remains composed and readable. Mobile, however, feels compressed rather than fully art-directed: metadata and helper copy are extremely small, precedent rows become tall and sparse, the CTA panel is cramped, and the global header drops the brand name while exposing a clipped horizontal nav with an ambiguous “SWIPE →” cue. The severe scale shift from desktop to mobile reduces polish and scanability below demo-ready 8.
critique.fix: Give mobile a dedicated compact composition: raise metadata/body type sizes, tighten each precedent row by placing rank and similarity on one line, reduce excess vertical padding, stack the explanation and CTA with clearer spacing, and replace the clipped header rail/“SWIPE” fragment with an explicit compact navigation control while retaining the brand identifier.
